Meet our PhD Students
ISTA cross-disciplinary research institution, our research groups interact with each other across the boundaries of traditional disciplines. So it’s not only about physics or biology or chemistry or mathematics — but also all the varieties in between. You can also find more information on upcoming Talks, Events and Courses on the dedicated Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics site Physics & Beyond page.
Physics at ISTA comprises a variety of theoretical and experimental approaches in the following areas:
Astronomy
Bugnet, Caiazzo, Götberg, Haiman, Matthee
Earth Science/ Geophysics
Fatichi, Muller, Pellicciotti
Atomic, Molecular and Optical Physics
Baykusheva, Danzl, Fink, Hosten, Lemeshko, Leonard, Roques-Carmes, Serbyn
Quantum physics
Alpichshev, Baykusheva, Fink, Hosten, Katsaros, Leonard, Venkataraman
Condensed Matter
Alpichshev, Baykusheva, Fink, Ibanez, Katsaros, Lemeshko, Leonard, Modic, Polshyn, Roques-Carmes, Serbyn, Sunko, Venkataraman
Soft Matter and Biophysics
Danzl, Fernandez-Rico, Goodrich, Hannezo, Palacci, Saric, Schanda, Stricker, Tkacik, Waitukaitis
Optics and Photonics
Baykusheva, Danzl, Hosten, Fink, Roques-Carmes
Mathematical physics
Erdös, Seiringer
